Jannik Sinner Withdraws From Cincinnati Open Due to Knee Injury

World number one tennis player Jannik Sinner has withdrawn from the Cincinnati Open due to a right knee injury. This withdrawal impacts his preparation for the upcoming US Open. He joins world number two Carlos Alcaraz, who also withdrew from the tournament.
